data.title: Verspätungszuschlag zur Einkommensteuer 2023 – Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf notifies David Muster that a late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) of €75.00 has been assessed for the 2023 income tax return under § 152 AO, to be paid within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Because your 2023 income tax return arrived late, the tax office (Finanzamt) has fixed a surcharge of €75. You need to pay this amount by the deadline shown, which is counted from when the letter is legally considered delivered to you (usually a few days after it was posted). If you think the surcharge is wrong, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the same office, in writing or electronically, by the deadline shown. If you do neither, the assessment becomes final and the surcharge stays owed. This kind of letter is common in Germany and does not itself require professional help, but if you want to contest it, consider getting advice from a tax advisor (Steuerberater).

key_facts.label: Verspätungszuschlag amount
key_facts.quote: Nach § 152 AO wird ein Verspätungszuschlag in Höhe von 75,00 € festgesetzt.

remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist der Einspruch zulässig. Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
